evidence_spans: Broadband Directional Coupler using PNGF-Accelerated DBS
All comparisons were run on the same server (dual AMD Epyc 7763 CPUs) using 128 cores unless stated otherwise.
CLM-PHOT-0048.statement: The DBS optimization of the broadband directional coupler using PNGF takes 82.9 seconds on 128 cores.

extra_quotes: All comparisons were run on the same server (dual AMD Epyc 7763 CPUs) using 128 cores unless stated otherwise.

Under typical conditions, the optimization can be started from a random initial guess and follow this workflow directly. However, the approach may suffer from near non-differentiability and can become trapped in local minima, particularly when initialized with an intuitive but suboptimal design, as discussed in sections S9 and S11 of the Supplementary Information.
